41/S0.subgoal: Explain the context of the lecture and recap the basic concepts of immersive system design.

41/S1.subgoal: State the three core objectives and the primary design considerations for the Majuli VR tour case study.

41/S2.subgoal: Describe the iterative development approach and the cycle of prototyping and evaluation used in the design process.

41/S3.subgoal: Explain the steps taken in user experience design, including identifying distinct user categories and mapping key locations.

41/S4.subgoal: Describe the design choices for the initial experience of the virtual tour, including introductory elements and transport mechanics.

41/S5.subgoal: Explain the content processing techniques used to enhance the visual quality and realism of the tour's media.

41/S6.subgoal: Detail the components and design inspiration behind the virtual tablet interface and the world-in-miniature concept.

41/S7.subgoal: Explain how global and local minimaps assist users with orientation and navigation on the island.

41/S8.subgoal: Describe the techniques for smooth user exploration, including view interpolation and the virtual vehicle metaphor for long-distance travel.

41/S9.subgoal: Explain how video, textual, and directional information is delivered to the user at specific points of interest.

41/S10.subgoal: Discuss the design implementations used to minimize cyber sickness during the virtual tour experience.

41/S11.subgoal: Summarize the key design concepts covered and preview the topics for the next lecture.
